summary_en: Yoshicon authorized repurchase of up to 200,000 shares (2.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum total of ¥500 million through May 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027, using market purchases including ToSTNeT-3.
title_en: Notice Regarding Market Repurchase of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On April 30, 2026, Yoshicon's board of directors resolved to repurchase up to 200,000 shares of its own common stock, representing 2.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate amount of ¥500 million. The repurchase will be conducted through market purchases, including transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange via ToSTNeT-3 (off-auction trading), from May 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

This notice reports execution during the period September 1 to September 30, 2026. As of September 30, 2026, the company had cumulatively acquired 134,500 shares for a total of ¥293,042,800 since May 1, 2026, consuming approximately 67% of the authorized share quantity and 59% of the authorized budget. No shares were purchased during the September reporting period.
